fails_if: the register loader accepts an [[errata.occurrence_period]] edition_scope bound that is not a real ISO date, which the compile then reads as unresolved and reports as a stale entry
note: The first interval's bare years are the allowed twin (errata-occurrence-period-source-coordinates-load); only 2019-02-30 is impossible.

message_contains: edition_scope bounds must be an ISO date
